verdict.rationale: Secureframe offers a public API that can reach any existing object in an account, push raw data to an endpoint, and create custom resources. It also ships an official MCP server, including a headless mode for scripts and CI, that exposes controls, tests, vendors, risks and frameworks as tools an agent can call to drive the product programmatically. Missing for 10: API reference documentation (endpoints, auth, write-operation coverage, rate limits) beyond feature-page claims, and independent or hands-on corroboration that the API works as described.
